_readme: Business settings for buildocrat.store. Edit numbers here, then run python3 pipeline/build.py (or let the weekly Action do it). Percentages are decimals: 0.05 = 5%.
address: No 30 Anthony Enahoro Street, Utako, Abuja
_buyMargin: Added to the rate book market price (Abuja) to give the Buildocrat selling price shown on the site.
_stateExtra: Extra uplift on top of the nearest rate-book city factor for states far from a hub. Delivery itself is always quoted separately on WhatsApp.
